user.title: Eaton ePDU G3
user.description: Address of the ePDU's network card. Daisy-chained units are found automatically.

data_description.snmp_version: G3 firmware offers SNMPv1 and SNMPv3. Use v3 unless you have deliberately enabled v1/v2c.

reconfigure.title: Eaton ePDU G3
reconfigure.description: Change how Home Assistant reaches this PDU.

data_description.write_community: Only needed for outlet switching. Leave empty to use the read community.

v3.title: SNMPv3 credentials
v3.description: Must match a user configured on the PDU under Settings → Network → SNMP.

data_description.auth_protocol: Choose 'none' for noAuthNoPriv, otherwise the protocol set on the PDU (G3 uses SHA for authNoPriv).

error.cannot_connect: No SNMP response. Check the address, the port, and that SNMP is enabled on the PDU.
error.invalid_auth: The PDU rejected these credentials. Check the user name, protocol and password, and that the user has read access.
error.no_epdu_data: The device answered but returned no Eaton ePDU data. Check that the SNMP user is allowed to read the Eaton MIB.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.wrong_device: That is a different PDU than the one being reconfigured.

data.command_delay: Delay before re-reading after a switch command (seconds)
data.temperature_unit: Temperature unit reported by the PDU
data.expose_unmapped: Create sensors for unmapped MIB columns

data_description.max_repetitions: Ignored on SNMPv1, which has no GETBULK.
data_description.temperature_unit: 'auto' detects the scale from the PDU. Set it explicitly if temperatures look wrong.
data_description.expose_unmapped: Adds a diagnostic sensor for every column this integration does not name. Useful for exploring the MIB.

outlet_on.name: Turn outlet on
outlet_on.description: Switch an outlet on, optionally after a delay.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds the PDU waits before acting. 0 acts immediately.

outlet_off.name: Turn outlet off
outlet_off.description: Switch an outlet off, optionally after a delay.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds the PDU waits before acting. 0 acts immediately.

outlet_cycle.name: Power cycle outlet
outlet_cycle.description: Switch an outlet off and back on, using the PDU's configured reboot-off time.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds the PDU waits before acting. 0 acts immediately.

dump_oids.name: Dump SNMP OIDs
dump_oids.description: Walk the PDU and write every OID it returns to a JSON file in the Home Assistant configuration folder.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Limit the dump to one PDU. Leave empty to dump all of them.
